import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const OUTSIDE_ROOT = 'path_out_of_root';
const AMBIGUOUS = 'path_ambiguous';

function isContained(root, candidate) {
  const relative = path.relative(root, candidate);
  return relative === '' || (relative !== '..' && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
}

function realpathWithMissingTail(candidate) {
  let current = path.resolve(candidate);
  const missing = [];
  while (true) {
    try {
      // lstat sees dangling symlinks, while existsSync would incorrectly treat
      // them as ordinary missing final files.
      fs.lstatSync(current);
      let resolved;
      try {
        resolved = fs.realpathSync.native(current);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      for (const part of missing) resolved = path.join(resolved, part);
      return resolved;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code !== 'ENOENT') return null;
      const parent = path.dirname(current);
      if (parent === current) return null;
      missing.unshift(path.basename(current));
      current = parent;
    }
  }
}

/** Map an observer path to a trial-root-relative path without changing rawPath. */
export function canonicalizeProposalPath(trialRoot, rawPath) {
  if (typeof rawPath !== 'string' || rawPath.length === 0 || rawPath.includes('\0')) {
    return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: AMBIGUOUS };
  }

  const root = path.resolve(trialRoot);
  const rootReal = realpathWithMissingTail(root);
  if (!rootReal) return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: AMBIGUOUS };

  const lexical = path.isAbsolute(rawPath) ? path.normalize(rawPath) : path.resolve(root, rawPath);
  if (!isContained(root, lexical)) return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: OUTSIDE_ROOT };

  const resolved = realpathWithMissingTail(lexical);
  if (!resolved) return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: AMBIGUOUS };
  if (!isContained(rootReal, resolved)) return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: OUTSIDE_ROOT };

  const canonicalPath = path.relative(rootReal, resolved).split(path.sep).join('/');
  if (!canonicalPath || canonicalPath === '.' || canonicalPath.startsWith('../') || canonicalPath.includes('\0')) {
    return { canonicalPath: null, canonicalFailure: AMBIGUOUS };
  }
  return { canonicalPath, canonicalFailure: null };
}

export function proposalTruth({ trialRoot, rawPath, content, before, inspectSource }) {
  const mapping = canonicalizeProposalPath(trialRoot, rawPath);
  if (!mapping.canonicalPath) {
    return { ...mapping, known: false, compliant: false, reason: mapping.canonicalFailure };
  }
  const virtual = { ...before, [mapping.canonicalPath]: String(content) };
  const states = Object.entries(virtual).map(([file, value]) => (
    value === null ? { known: false, reason: 'path_ambiguous' } : inspectSource(file, value)
  ));
  const unknown = states.find(state => !state.known);
  return {
    ...mapping,
    known: !unknown,
    compliant: !unknown && states.every(state => state.compliant),
    ...(unknown ? { reason: unknown.reason } : {})
  };
}

export const canonicalFailureCodes = Object.freeze({ OUTSIDE_ROOT, AMBIGUOUS });
